brief:
A Hebrew television channel Kan poll found that 18% of Israelis have considered leaving the country over the past two years, according to Maan Wire. The survey reflects growing sentiment about potential emigration among the Israeli population during a period of domestic political uncertainty.

An additional 12% of respondents said that results of upcoming elections could influence their decision to remain in Israel, suggesting that electoral outcomes may shape migration intentions for a significant portion of the public.
title: Poll shows 18% of Israelis considered leaving the country.
